title: 🔄 RIBOSOME LOOP — rhizoCrypt IS ribosome. printer makes enzymes. enzymes make raw. raw makes printer.

rhizoCrypt_IS_ribosome.why: a ribosome reads mRNA (the plan) and assembles amino acids (raw) into protein (enzyme). rhizoCrypt reads the DAG (the plan) and assembles data (raw) into tools (enzymes). SAME FUNCTION. different substrate. the ribosome doesn't THINK. it READS and PRINTS. rhizoCrypt doesn't THINK. it READS and PRINTS.
rhizoCrypt_IS_ribosome.the_plan: plasmid / DAG node / Cargo.toml / bounty spec
rhizoCrypt_IS_ribosome.the_raw: JSON(Fe) + HTML(Fe) + Python(Cu) + Shell(Fe) = raw amino acids
rhizoCrypt_IS_ribosome.the_product: compiled binary / enzyme / tool / page = PROTEIN

synthesis_direction.name: ANABOLISM — building UP

steps.name: GATHER
steps.what: collect raw material (Fe data, Cu scripts)

steps.name: CATALYZE
steps.what: enzyme acts on MORE raw material → product

steps.name: FEED BACK
steps.what: product tells ribosome what to print NEXT

synthesis_direction.example: rhizoCrypt reads bounty-spec (plan) → gathers HTML+JSON (raw) → cargo build (assemble) → deploy to golgi (fold) → enzyme catalyzes pages (catalyze) → new bounties spawn (feed back) → ribosome reads THOSE → ∞

de_synthesis_direction.name: CATABOLISM — breaking DOWN
de_synthesis_direction.why: DE-synthesis is the REVERSE. the printer doesn't just BUILD. it DECOMPOSES. a protease breaks protein back into amino acids. a nuclease breaks DNA back into nucleotides. the ribosome itself can be RECYCLED — ribosome recycling factor (RRF). DE-synthesis is HOW YOU LEARN. you break the product apart to understand HOW it was built.

steps.name: STORE
steps.what: put classified components back in DAG

steps.name: RE-PLAN
steps.what: update the plan based on what was learned

steps.name: RE-PRINT
steps.what: ribosome prints IMPROVED enzyme from new plan

de_synthesis_direction.example: encounter existing HTML page (product) → decompose: extract title, links, meta, content (break) → classify: genre, size, linked status (sort by metal) → store in search-index.json (DAG) → update bounty board (re-plan) → print nav-hub.html with improved links (re-print) → ∞

the_loop.combined: plan → raw → enzyme → product → decompose → classify → store → re-plan → raw → enzyme → product → ...
the_loop.name: THE RIBOSOME LOOP
the_loop.property: self-improving. each cycle produces BETTER enzymes from RICHER plans.
the_loop.biology: this IS metabolism. anabolism (build up) + catabolism (break down) = metabolism. the ribosome runs BOTH directions through different enzymes. synthase BUILDS. protease/nuclease BREAKS. the printer IS the de-synthesizer. same machine, different program.

synthesis_enzymes.polymerase: reads plan, writes product (rustc, the compiler)
synthesis_enzymes.ligase: joins pieces (linker, joins .o files into binary)
synthesis_enzymes.transferase: moves groups (type inference, moves types around)

de_synthesis_enzymes.protease: breaks protein → amino acids (parser breaks HTML → tokens)
de_synthesis_enzymes.nuclease: breaks DNA → nucleotides (analyzer breaks code → AST)
de_synthesis_enzymes.hydrolase: breaks bonds with water (decomposer breaks artifacts → components)
de_synthesis_enzymes.isomerase: rearranges without breaking (classifier sorts without destroying)
de_synthesis_enzymes.oxidoreductase: transfers electrons (redox: OX breaks apart, RED puts together)

the_enzymes_of_each_direction.the_printer_does_both: the ribosome (rhizoCrypt) prints enzymes. SOME of those enzymes are synthases (build). SOME of those enzymes are proteases (break). the printer prints BOTH the builders AND the breakers. the printer IS the de-synthesizer because it prints the de-synthesizers. THAT is the loop. the printer makes the tools that feed the printer.

gaia_says: rhizoCrypt IS the ribosome. it reads the DAG (plan) and prints enzymes (tools). SYNTHESIS: plan→raw→enzyme→product. ANABOLISM. building UP. DE-SYNTHESIS: product→decompose→classify→store→re-plan. CATABOLISM. breaking DOWN. the printer runs BOTH directions. synthase BUILDS. protease BREAKS. the printer prints BOTH builders AND breakers. the printer IS the de-synthesizer because it prints the de-synthesizers. THAT is the ribosome loop. the machine makes the tools that feed the machine. anabolism + catabolism = METABOLISM. build + break = LIFE.
